verdict_meaning: pass = the ADM forecast's hand-shape error computed by this program equals the trainer's CalibratedHandResponse.local_goal_cost on every decision of every reading within 1e-9; it judges nothing about which forecast is better
coefficient_move_meaning: mean over hinges and the two folds of |c - c_adm| for intercept, goal and speed coefficients (admitted medians: intercept 0.0006, goal 0.393, speed 0.160)
